system.description: • Effect: While exactly one enemy is within your reach, after each attack you make against it you may move 10ft, on top of your speed, without provoking Attacks of Opportunity from it, and you have Advantage on saves against its spells and abilities.

rules.value: Duel's Rhythm: while exactly one enemy is within your reach, after each attack against it you may move 10ft (on top of your speed) without provoking Attacks of Opportunity from it.

rules.when: against the spells and abilities of the one enemy within your reach (while it is the only one)
